traffic.description:
The traffic display list, nearest first and at most [`MAX_SNAPSHOT_TRAFFIC`] aircraft, with each
controller highlight already applied. A remote screen has no fleet, so this is its only source.

AcsTolerances.description: FAA-S-ACS-8 task tolerances. Timing/leg margins are instructor criteria, not ACS quotations.

Action.description: What the figure does for an item.

oneOf.description: Look at a point, optionally touching it ("condition", "secure").

Move control surfaces by hand through their full travel. `parts` are exterior
`moving_parts` node names; `target_m` is where the hand takes hold.
Open a fuel filler cap and look at the level inside.
Pull the oil tank dipstick and read it between its minimum and maximum marks.
Handle the propeller blade area with the palm of the hand. Ignition must be off.
Remove covers, ropes, or chocks.
An item done from the cockpit.

AirspeedMode.description: How airspeed is controlled. Pitch mode trades excess speed for climb at full power.

AlternateKnobs.description: The "Right Side Knob Action" setting: what the alternate PFD knob does.

oneOf.description: Inner: course. Outer: baro. The default.
Inner: flight director bug. Outer: baro.
Mirrors the main knob: heading and altitude.

threshold.description: Volts, pascals, or degrees Celsius, for threshold sources; zero otherwise.

oneOf.description: Oil pressure below the threshold (pascals) with the engine running.
Oil temperature above the threshold (degrees Celsius).
A cowl fastener is loose and the engine is making power: airframe vibration.

ApproachIntercept.description: A heading and altitude restriction remain in force until the final course is established.

oneOf.description: Touch-and-go landing clearance (JO 7110.65 3-9-4); used for circuit traffic.
Speed adjustment (JO 7110.65 5-7-1); `None` cancels the restriction.

closed_traffic.description: Closed traffic has been accepted by a completed, heard pilot readback.

radio_discipline.description: Traffic advisories answered and radio-discipline faults while busy-airspace traffic runs.

AudioPanelInstallation.description: A pack may give the audio panel and each COM an independent breaker load.

AutopilotInstallation.description: Normalised control force is used for servo torque: 1 is full pilot authority.

oneOf.description: A look or a hand check with no switch involved.
Move the flap control to full down.
Read the fuel quantity indicator.
First-person view from the Corvid left seat.
Close, slightly elevated view of the pre-flight figure and the part being checked.

control.description: Panel element id to highlight on the dash.

note.description: Extra caution or note shown beneath the item.

poh_ref.description: Section of the pilot's operating handbook, e.g. "POH 4.5.2 item 7".

response.description: The response ("on", "clear of people and obstructions").

stop_on_failure.description:
A go/no-go gate: if the verify binding is unmet or fails, the pilot must stop (abort)
rather than carry on to later items.

text.description: The challenge, as read from the POH.

unverified.description:
Set when a number comes from outside the pilot's operating handbook and has not been
verified against that source ("per Rotax 912 iS operator's manual, not verified").

ChecklistLimit.description: A condition that must not be allowed to persist; shown as a warning while it holds.

ChecklistPhase.description: Which part of the flight a checklist covers; drives the ground layout and lesson selection.

ClockFormat.description: Which time the clock field shows.

oneOf.description:
Local time at the aircraft: UTC plus the longitude's nautical time zone, one hour per 15
degrees (rounded), as a unit without a time-zone database shows it.

ClockReadout.description: The clock and flight timer as the data bar shows them, at the snapshot's simulation time.

seconds.description: Seconds from midnight in the chosen format.

timer_expired.description: A count-down timer that has reached zero.

timer_s.description: The timer's value: elapsed counting up, remaining counting down.

position_estimated.description: NASR gives a facility/airport reference point, not necessarily a remote antenna site.

antenna_agl_m.description: Engineering estimate, not an FAA-published antenna height.

channel_khz.description: Channel designator in kHz, not the rounded 8.33 kHz carrier.

source.description: FAA source URL or file/record identifier, retained by the importer.

temperature_c.description: Sea-level reference observations; station temperature uses a standard lapse rate.

Controls.description: Pilot controls. Each value is clamped to its range when set.

CowlState.description: A loose cowl fastener: vibration under power, and separation if flown fast.

stress_s.description: Accumulated lift stress, in seconds at the reference excess speed.

vibration.description: The airframe is vibrating from the loose cowl.

DataArea.description: What the MFD page's data column shows beside the map.

DataBarField.description:
What the data bar's user field (the slot of the minimum safe altitude on the guide's data
bar) shows.

oneOf.description: The minimum safe altitude; the engine models none and shows dashes.
The clock, in the chosen format.
The flight timer.

DefectKind.description: Findings an instructor or lesson can seed. The first three are physical props left on.

cue_m.description: Body-frame position of the visual cue on the model.

description.description: What the student sees and reads when the item reveals it.

corner_knobs.description: Knob centres in local installation mm; zero, one, or two knobs.

margins.description: Left, top, right, bottom margins, in mm.

model.description:
A display model supplies the bezel geometry and control set; `margins`, soft keys, and
corner knobs are then ignored and the installation must have the model's bezel aspect.

DisplayModel.description: A display class the engine knows how to draw and operate.

oneOf.description: 10.6-inch landscape touch EFIS with a bottom row of physical controls.

press_to_toggle.description: "Press to toggle knob action": an inner-knob push swaps main and alternate functions.

backup_capacity_ah.description: Zero for equipment without an internal battery.

battery_current_a.description: Positive discharges the battery; negative charges it.

airspeed_trend_kt.description: Six-second prediction, in knots relative to the current tape value.

cdi.description: Positive right of course, clamped at the displayed full-scale stops.

fuel_flow_kg_s.description: Fuel flow against normalised shaft power, kg/s. Metadata until fuel burn is implemented.

gearbox_ratio.description: Engine revolutions per propeller revolution. Propulsion RPM limits remain propeller limits.

propulsion.description: Shaft power versus density ratio and fixed-pitch propeller CT/CP versus advance ratio.

lane_a_only_power_fraction.description:
Power fraction with only lane A running; defaults to `single_lane_power_fraction`.
The Sling 2 POH allows no drop with lane B off, so its lane A carries the engine fully.

lane_b_only_power_fraction.description: Power fraction with only lane B running; defaults to `single_lane_power_fraction`.

manifold_pressure_fraction.description: Absolute inlet pressure / ambient pressure against throttle demand.

carb_ice_rate.description: Icing accumulation per second against ambient temperature (degrees Celsius).

oil.description: Engine oil system. Optional in a pack: the defaults are the Rotax 912 iS figures.

EntryTarget.description: What a keypad is entering a value for.

oneOf.description: Altimeter barometric setting, inHg or hPa as the display's units.
Selected heading, degrees magnetic.
Selected altitude, feet.
Selected course (OBS), degrees magnetic.
Barometric minimums altitude, feet.
Direct-to waypoint identifier.
Standby frequency of the first communication radio.
Standby frequency of the first navigation radio.
Transponder code.
Identifier of a waypoint to insert before the selected flight-plan waypoint.
Identifier of a waypoint to insert after the selected flight-plan waypoint.

recommended_skin.description:
A soft reference to a skin pack id. It is used when that pack is installed and the pilot has
not chosen another; otherwise the built-in public skin is shown.

skin.description: Host registry artwork id; omission selects original artwork.

essential.description:
Optional essential rectangle [left, top, width, height], in panel millimetres.
Short viewports anchor cropping around this area without distorting the panel.

shell.description: Optional shell artwork. All coordinates and dimensions are millimetres.

matches.description: Exact selected text, before field parsing, for the Test view.

Failures.description:
Actual deflections override pilot/autopilot demands until cleared. Zero power
means a failed engine, including removal of idle shaft power.

cowl_loose.description: An engine cowl fastener is loose: vibration, and the cowl can come off at speed.

cowl_separated.description: The cowl has come off: a large drag increase and loss of engine cooling.

damaged_tyre.description: A worn or cut tyre on this wheel: it rolls harder and drags that side.

fairing_crack.description: A cracked wheel fairing: a small parasite-drag increase.

tyre_flat.description: The damaged tyre has burst: very high rolling resistance on that wheel.

deflection_deg.description:
Surface deflection of this detent in degrees, for the flap position indicator's scale
(the POH's figure, not derived from `position`). Optional: without it the indicator
shows the position only.

FleetCall.description: Tags a simulated-traffic transmission for voices, captions, and display correlation.

exchange.description: Calls that belong together (instruction, readback, correction) share this number.

for_user.description: Traffic never addresses the user; the user answers only calls with their own callsign.

voice.description: Stable voice index 0-7: the aircraft's for pilots, the facility's for controllers.

oneOf.description: The controller corrects a wrong readback.

FleetSequence.description: The landing number the controller gave, and the aircraft it follows.

FlightTimer.description:
The flight timer: counts up from zero, or down from a preset to zero. It runs on simulation
time, so it stops with the simulation when paused.

accumulated_s.description: Seconds counted before the current run began.

started_at_s.description: Simulation time the current run began at.

cap_m.description: Body-frame position of the filler cap, metres.

tank.description: Tank id from the systems definition.

covers_bottom_l.description: Litres at which fuel can just be seen covering the whole bottom of a tank.

density_kg_per_l.description: Fuel density used to convert tank mass to litres.

clock_format.description: Which time the clock field shows.

clock_start_utc_s.description: Time of day (UTC, seconds) at simulation time zero; the clock runs on simulation time.

data_bar_field.description: What the data bar's user field shows.

fpl_cursor.description: The waypoint selected on the FPL page, for Insert, Remove, and Activate Leg.

minimums_m.description: Barometric minimums altitude, metres MSL; none until the pilot sets one.

traffic_filter.description: The altitude window traffic is shown in.

traffic_shown.description: Traffic on the MFD map (needs an ADS-B In installation).

nearest_vors.description:
Nearest VORs, NDBs, intersections, and airspace. Filled only while a display shows the
matching nearest page; empty otherwise.

terrain.description: Map coordinates are fractions of a square spanning twice the selected range.

traffic_alert.description: A traffic alert is active: the PFD shows the TRAFFIC annunciation.

traffic_installed.description: An ADS-B In (or TIS-B) receiver feeds this aircraft's glass displays.

cdi_deviation.description: Positive needle displacement commands a correction to the right.

GpsWaypoint.description: A resolved GPS waypoint; independent of a region's airport catalogue.

preflight.description: Exterior pre-flight walkaround. Requires pack format version 4.

procedures.description: Normal-procedure checklists (before start through securing), versioned independently.

Instruction.description: Typed meaning shared by scripted and live facility transmissions. No automatic ATC rules.

position.description: Panel grid position and size, in arbitrary panel units.

skin.description: Runtime skin registry id. Omitted declarations use the original public skin.

cdi_scale.description: Signed fraction of full-scale indication; independent of receiver dot count.

oneOf.description:
Listening discipline on a busy frequency: answer traffic advisories, answer only calls that
use your callsign, and do not transmit over others.

defects.description: Findings an instructor may seed on this item, with their text and cue.

node.description: Route node to stand at, when it differs from the station's own.

optional.description: Skipping an optional item is not graded as a miss.

poh_ref.description: Handbook section and list, for example `4.4 (4) Right wing and main gear`.

warning.description: A handbook warning or caution that applies to the item.

coverage.description: FEW, SCT, BKN, OVC, or VV. Unknown heights remain None.

pixels_per_mm.description: Independent X and Y monitor calibration; CSS mm are never assumed physical.

observed_at.description: Unix UTC seconds; None when the source provides no observation time.

MapDeclutter.description: Declutter distances are the visible span across the map's horizontal dimension, in nautical miles.

centre.description: Null follows the aircraft; a position pins the centre in the active region's frame.

chart_track_rad.description: Direction of travel on the chart, radians clockwise from the screen top.

highlighted.description: A controller's call named this aircraft within the last 20 seconds.

registration.description: Written registration, the label glass units draw.

inertia_kg_m2.description: Full symmetric positive-definite tensor about the CG, in body axes.

mass_kg.description: Resolved total flight mass, including occupants and fuel.

oneOf.description: Local recognition evidence, shown before the student approves a transmission. Never graded.

A controller traffic advisory to the user (JO 7110.65 2-1-21). The numbers are the spoken
ones and are computed from the same positions `traffic.state` reports at that instant, so
displays can highlight `target_aircraft` (ids from `traffic.state`) and match the words.

callsign.description: The reported aircraft's full spoken callsign.

clock.description: Clock position (1-12) relative to the user's ground track.

direction.description: Direction of flight as spoken: `opposite direction`, `eastbound`, ...

miles.description: Exact range in NM; the controller says it rounded to whole miles (`miles_spoken`).

relative_altitude_ft.description: Traffic altitude minus the user's, feet.

target_aircraft.description: `traffic.state` aircraft ids the advisory is about.

updated.description: `Traffic now ...` follow-up to an earlier advisory about the same aircraft.

user_track_true_deg.description: The user's ground track the clock position was measured from, true degrees.

voice.description: Stable controller voice index 0-7, as for `fleet` calls.

oneOf.description:
A controller follow-up to the user's reply to an advisory: `Traffic no factor`, `Maintain
visual separation from that traffic`, `Follow that traffic`.
A simulated-traffic transmission: controller or AI pilot, tagged for voices and display.

lane_a_weak.description: Seeded weak-ignition faults; absent from the hash words unless set.

audio_panel.description: Whether the navigator hosts the panel's shared audio installation.

nav_active_khz.description: The active frequency is the NAV receiver tuning boundary.

NearestAirspace.description: A piece of airspace the aircraft is in or about to enter.

entry_s.description: Seconds until entry; zero when inside now.

NearestFacility.description: A VOR, NDB, or intersection near the aircraft.

detail.description: Facility class: VOR, VOR/DME, VORTAC, NDB, or empty.

NearestPage.description: A page of the nearest group, chosen on the page navigation bar once NEAREST is pressed.

layers.description: Some(empty) means explicitly clear; None means unreported.

time.description: DDHHMMZ, resolved against retrieval time by the source runtime.

OilDefinition.description:
Engine oil quantity, pressure limits, and how a shortage damages the engine.

Defaults follow the BRP-Rotax 912 iS operator's manual (OM-912 iS): see
`docs/preflight.md` for the figures and where each comes from.

consumption_l_h.description: Oil burned per hour at full power, litres. The manual's permitted maximum is 0.1.

full_l.description: Oil in the tank at the dipstick MAX mark, litres.

low_finding_l.description: Oil quantity a "low oil" pre-flight finding leaves in the tank, litres.

max_temperature_c.description: Maximum permitted oil temperature, degrees Celsius.

min_mark_l.description: Oil at the dipstick MIN mark, litres. Below this the engine is unfit to fly.

starve_l.description: Oil below which the pump draws air and pressure is lost, litres.

starved_temperature_rise_c.description: Oil temperature rise at the starvation point, degrees Celsius.

wear_out_s.description: Seconds at full load for starvation to wear the engine out.

OilState.description: Engine oil quantity and the damage a shortage does.

disturbed.description: A low-oil finding has been applied; gates the extra state hash words.

fill.description: Oil in the tank as a fraction of the dipstick MAX mark.

seized.description: The engine has seized for want of oil and cannot be restarted.

wear.description: Starvation wear, 0 (sound) to 1 (worn out and seized).

Overlay.description: A keypad or menu shown over the display.

oneOf.description: MENU on a full-screen PFD: navigation tools and More Options.
MENU on any other screen: options for the page.
A second MENU press.
Direct-to waypoint entry (the identifier keypad).
A touch keypad for a PFD box: baro, heading, altitude, or course.
The COM1 standby window: frequencies, transfer, and the frequency keypad.
The NAV1 standby window.
The transponder window: code keypad and mode keys.
The Select Page menu, opened from the page bar.

instruments.description: Empty selects the aircraft's full panel. Instrument pages select one module id.

item.description: An equipment installation id for an independently movable switch, knob, or breaker.

PaneSide.description: Where the MFD pane sits in split mode. The PFD uses the knob on the other side.

audio_panel.description: Omitted installations share the existing avionics load and retain legacy power demand.

touch_controls.description: Original touch ergonomics for independently placed controls; values are normalized commands.

default_page.description:
The page shown at power-up. Omission shows `layout`, as packs always have. A two-display
installation declares `mfd` here on the screen that is the multi-function display.

layout.description: The installed primary-flight-display layout; also what the PFD soft key selects.

audio_panel.description: Host this aircraft panel's shared `audio_panel` installation on an Audio page.

oneOf.description:
Throttle lever on the cabin centre console. Forward (up) is more power; it sets the pilot's
throttle, as the keyboard, joystick, and `sim.set_controls` do.
Hand brake lever on the centre console: held, it applies the wheel brakes.
Brake intercept valve handle, the parking brake: closed, it keeps the brakes applied.
Rotary flap selector with one detent at each of the aircraft's flap stages.

The pilot's control-stick grip seen from above, nose up the page, with the POH button
allocation: 1 trim down (forward), 3 trim up (aft), 2 autopilot, 4 not allocated, 5 push to
talk. The trim buttons are live; the sticks themselves are flown with the flight controls.

floor.description:
The cabin floor under the centre console, drawn behind it in the console window: the
footwells that the control sticks stand in.

oneOf.description: `Looking for the traffic` after an advisory.
`Traffic in sight`: the pilot sees the reported traffic.
`Negative contact`: the pilot cannot see the reported traffic.

PilotSeat.description: Where the pilot sits. A right-seat pilot gets the primary flight display on the right screen.

position_error_pa.description: Static pressure error (Pa) against normalized flap position.

Power.description: Each unit has its own rechargeable battery. Endurance is at rated continuous load.

keepouts.description: Plan-view rectangles the figure never enters: wings, fuselage, tail, and the propeller disc.

pace_mps.description: Walking pace in metres per second at real time.

props.description: Covers, ropes, and chocks present on a parked aircraft.

route.description: A closed loop of ground points around the aircraft. The figure only walks along it.

seat_m.description: Where the pilot sits when an item is done from the cockpit: the hip point on the seat.

source.description: Where the list comes from, for example the handbook revision and section.

version.description: Document version of this section. Currently 1.

ProcedureSet.description: All normal-procedure checklists of an aircraft, with an explicit data version.

source.description: Document and revision the lists were transcribed from.

node.description: Route node where the figure stands to take it off.

present_at_start.description: Present when a parked-aircraft walkaround begins.

RadioDiscipline.description: Radio-discipline tally for the debrief: calls to the user that were answered, and the faults.

acknowledged_other.description: Read back or acknowledged an instruction given to another aircraft.

advisories_answered.description: Advisories the user answered (looking, in sight, negative contact, or an acknowledgment).

advisories_issued.description: Initial traffic advisories spoken to the user.

no_response.description: Advisories still unanswered after the repeat.

stepped_on.description: Keyed the microphone while a traffic or controller transmission was on the frequency.

wrong_callsign.description: Answered or acknowledged a call that used another aircraft's callsign.

Readout.description: Derived values for instruments, agents, and tests.

altitude_msl_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level, metres.

autopilot.description: Engaged holds and their SI targets.

crashed.description: True once the aircraft has hit the ground too hard or off a gear contact.

effective_controls.description: Actual surface positions after applying jams (throttle remains a demand).

heading_grid_rad.description: Internal local-grid heading; use only for geometry and truth transports.

heading_rad.description: Pilot magnetic heading, radians, clockwise from magnetic north.

height_agl_m.description: Height of the lowest wheel above the ground, metres.

lateral_acceleration_g.description:
Aerodynamic specific force along body y, g, positive right.
A slip ball moves opposite this force; coordinated flight reads zero.

load_factor_g.description: Load factor along body z, g (1 in level flight).

on_ground.description: True while any wheel touches the ground.

sea_level_pressure_pa.description: Scenario sea-level pressure (QNH), used by pressure instruments.

turn_rate_rps.description:
Heading rate about the local vertical, rad/s, positive right.
Zero within 1e-6 rad of vertical pitch, where heading is undefined.

weather.description: Pilot weather readout; wind-from direction is magnetic.

wind_ned_mps.description: Total moving-air velocity at the CG, NED m/s.

initial_wind.description: Grid-referenced wind and MSL conditions, resolved when accepted, for exact replay.

oneOf.description: A wait installs a condition on advancement to the next step.

oneOf.title: id, .class, #id.class, or .class.other; no combinators or executable expressions.

turn_coordinator_rate_rps.description: Canted electric gyro: yaw rate plus roll-rate sensitivity for a rate autopilot.

oneOf.description: Do not fly until fixed.
Fix or accept knowingly; flying with it is graded down.

SrgbHex.description: Six-digit opaque sRGB, including the leading `#`.

angular_rate_rps.description: Angular rate in the body frame `[p, q, r]`, rad/s.

attitude.description: Attitude, body to world, as a unit quaternion `[w, x, y, z]`.

position_m.description: Position of the centre of gravity in the world (NED) frame, metres.

time_s.description: Simulated time since the start, seconds.

velocity_mps.description: Velocity in the world (NED) frame, m/s.

node.description: The route node where the figure stands for this station's items.

StationCamera.description: Framing for the exterior inset: look at `target_m`, from `target_m + eye_offset_m`.

target_m.description: Body-frame point (x forward, y right, z down), metres.

park_brake.description: Brake intercept valve closed: stops pressure relief so the wheel brakes stay applied.

flap_stages.description: Available normalised flap detents; continuous travel between detents is supported.

adsb_in.description:
Whether the glass displays are fed by an ADS-B In (or TIS-B) traffic receiver. Omission means
the receiver is installed whenever the aircraft has a glass display; `false` declares none, so
no glass page shows traffic or the TRAFFIC annunciation.

electric_gyro_load.description: Electric attitude/heading sensor; its installation must name an electrical load.

sliding_canopy.description: POH-declared cabin mechanism, independent of aircraft identity or artwork.

gyro_heading_reference_rad.description: Free heading gyro is aligned to the compass at reset, then retains this reference.

smoke_density.description: Normalized cockpit smoke obscuration; accumulates under a smoke source, clears after isolation.

points.description: [breakpoint, ordinate], linear interpolation, clamped at the edges.

station.description: Load station supplying this tank. Shared stations are divided by tank capacity.

Targets.description: Optional holds. Only one vertical hold and one lateral hold may be engaged at a time.

bank_limit_rad.description: Maximum commanded bank magnitude, radians (0.05 to 0.6).

elevation_m.description: North-up or track-up chart samples, left to right, top to bottom; null is uncovered.

TimerKind.description: How a POH time limit applies to an item.

oneOf.description: Counts while `start_when` holds; exceeding `seconds` warns (starter duty limit).

Counts from `start_when`; the item's `verify` must hold within `seconds` or the timer
expires with a warning (oil pressure within 10 s of start).
The item's `verify` must hold continuously for `seconds` to complete it (warm-up).

data_area.description: What the MFD page's data column shows.

default_page.description: The page this display shows at power-up for the pilot's seat, before any choice of the pilot's own.

installed_layout.description: The pack's installed layout: what the PFD key and menu entry select.

knob_toggle_until_s.description: While set and later than the host's clock, the knobs have swapped main and alternate roles.

knobs.description: Knob settings: alternate roles, press-to-toggle, split-pane side.

layout.description: The page the display shows (or would show, were it not reverted).

mfd_page.description: The MFD page shown full-screen or in the split pane.

model.description: The physical display model, when the installation declares one.

nearest_page.description: The nearest page shown when the MFD page is the nearest group.

overlay.description: A menu or keypad shown over the display.

recommended_skin.description: The skin pack id the aircraft pack recommends, whether or not it is installed.

skin.description: The skin pack in use; absent means the built-in public skin.

oneOf.description: Landscape split screen: the PFD beside one MFD pane showing the display's `MfdPage`.
Primary flight display with synthetic vision always on.
Large moving map with a configurable data area ([`DataArea`]) beside it.
Full-screen engine page.
Full-screen flight-plan list.
Full-screen nearest-airports list.
Full-screen traffic list.

manual_reversion.description: The pilot pressed display backup: the multi-function display shows the primary flight display.

oneOf.description: Hollow arrow.
Filled arrow.
Amber filled symbol and the TRAFFIC annunciation.

TrafficFilter.description: The altitude window a glass unit shows traffic in, relative to the aircraft.

oneOf.description: 2,700 ft above to 2,700 ft below.
9,900 ft above to 2,700 ft below.
2,700 ft above to 9,900 ft below.
9,900 ft above to 9,900 ft below.
`Traffic no factor.`
`Maintain visual separation from that traffic.`
`Follow that traffic.` (tower sequencing)
`Roger.` after traffic in sight, nothing more required.
Busy-airspace traffic controlled by the tower and approach rules.
A circuit aircraft started by `traffic.set`.

TrafficTarget.description: One other aircraft as the displays see it, from either traffic source.

address.description: Stable 24-bit address: `FLEET_ADDRESS_BASE + id` for the fleet. Also the GDL 90 address.

callsign.description: Spoken, such as `Cessna Four Two Seven Kilo Papa`.

closing.description: The aircraft is on course to pass the user inside the alert volume soon.

fleet_id.description: The fleet aircraft id that comms events carry (`target_aircraft`); none for circuit traffic.

highlighted.description: A recent controller call named this aircraft.

intent.description: Flow and phase, such as `arrival: final approach`.

track_grid_rad.description: Heading in the region's grid frame, for placing the symbol on a projected chart.

speaker_name.description: Rendered at emission so saved debriefs retain the imported radio call.

TurbulenceLevel.description: Original scenario presets: RMS gust velocity on each NED axis, m/s.

suction_pa.description: Pump suction (Pa below ambient) against engine RPM.

cg_envelope.description: Polygon vertices [longitudinal CG in metres, total mass in kg], ordered around its edge.

Verify.description: A condition on simulator state. Used for item completion, timers, and limit warnings.

oneOf.description: Ignition switches: both magnetos, or both electronic lanes with the key on.
Backup battery switch for a named circuit, optionally with a minimum voltage.
Any of the listed selector positions (`left`, `right`, `both`, `off`).
Any panel control by element id, in the control's own 0..1 range.
Crankshaft rpm.
Main bus voltage.
Wheel brakes applied at or above half pressure, by the lever or by the park-brake valve.
The brake intercept valve (the "park brake") is closed (`set`) or open.
Flap position as a fraction of full travel.
Pitch trim within `tolerance` of neutral (normalised, 0..0.3).
Sliding canopy closed and latched (always true on aircraft without one).
A run-up check the simulator has observed and found within limits.

One ignition lane switched off at `at_rpm`; the other must carry the engine. The recorded
drop must not exceed `max_drop_rpm` plus the measurement allowance `allow_rpm`.
One electric fuel pump alone keeps fuel pressure at or above `min_kpa`.
Every primary control moved to at least `min_deflection` both ways, and the flaps cycled.

Full throttle reaches `min_rpm` without exceeding `max_rpm`, accelerating from idle within
`within_s` seconds.
Every listed condition holds.
